landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order ahead and pick a collection time. Less queues, and food ready when they arrive.
landing.pricing.summary: Pro is {proPrice} a month with {proAllowance} of online orders included. Max is {maxPrice} with {maxAllowance}. Anything above that is {platformFee}. Standard card processing fees apply to all online orders (currently {cardFee} on standard {region}), including those within your allowance. Walk-ups carry no HatchGrab platform fee on any plan. Your card terminal's own fees still apply.

planFeatures.footnote.n1: Walk-up orders: HatchGrab charges 0% on every plan. Use your own card terminal and only your provider's standard fees apply. Card payments through HatchGrab via Stripe are coming soon — Stripe's own charge, currently around {inPersonFee} on {region}, plus {tapFee} per authorisation if you tap on a phone or tablet without a dedicated reader.
planFeatures.footnote.n2: Online payments powered by Stripe Connect. Subject to {platformFee} HatchGrab platform fee plus Stripe card processing fees (~{onlineFee} per transaction on standard {region}).
planFeatures.footnote.n5: Kitchen ticket printing requires the HatchGrab kitchen app and a compatible Bluetooth or wired printer (neither supplied). Compatible printers listed in our help centre.
planFeatures.landing.offlineProtectionDe: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses so customers can't place orders you won't see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app keeps you taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
planFeatures.row.offline_protection.deta: If your internet drops mid-service, orders are held safely and sync when you're back — you never lose one.
planFeatures.row.offline_protection.name: Offline Order Protection
planFeatures.row.sms_order_alerts.detail: Text customers automatically when their order's ready. Will carry an additional charge (price to be confirmed).
